penalties_applied.name: requires_human_fulfillment
penalties_applied.reason: Diagnosing and resolving OIDC federation + MDM policy conflicts requires deep environment-specific investigation; each customer's stack (Entra tenant config, Workspace domain allow-lists, Android Enterprise policy) is unique and cannot be fully automated — per-customer manual diagnostic work is unavoidable.

penalties_applied.name: high_touch_support
penalties_applied.reason: Enterprise IT environment misconfigurations generate ongoing support queries that require human judgment to triage (policy version changes, silent auth failures, org-specific edge cases).

rationale: The buyer is real and identifiable — IT admins at mid-market companies running hybrid Intune + Workspace stacks — and the pain is genuine and recurring. However, the solution fundamentally requires per-customer manual diagnostic work: every org's Entra tenant, Workspace domain allow-lists, and Android Enterprise policies are different, making fully automated delivery impossible. The operational_autonomy score of 3 fails the build gate (minimum 7), and the weighted total of 4.7 (post-penalty: 2.7) falls well below the validate threshold of 5.5. Drop until a templated, fully self-serve diagnostic tool can be scoped.
solution_plan: Not recommended for build or validation in current form. To make this viable, the factory would need to produce a fully self-serve diagnostic questionnaire that maps an IT admin's environment to a known-good configuration — but the problem space is too bespoke and environment-dependent for Claude + a static form to reliably resolve without human follow-up per customer. A solo non-technical operator cannot realistically build and maintain a support-free version of this service today.
notes: Fails operational_autonomy build gate (score 3, minimum 7). Also fails buildability_with_ai (score 4, minimum 6). Total post-penalty 2.7 is below validate threshold. Drop.
